entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I need to return these absolutely useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number 8675309. And you'd better look into it fast. I bought these over a month ago, and they're destroying my feet. I have blisters everywhere!

Okay, Sam, I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered 31 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or more of a sizing or preference issue?

What's the issue? The issue is they're garbage! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times and they still dig into my arches, and like I said, I have blisters. I don't want to troubleshoot, I don't want a different size, I want a refund. Are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration completely, and I do apologize for the discomfort the shoes have caused. There's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you.
Don't give me the runaround on some policy. If you don't process this refund right now, I'm going to leave a review on every single website I can find. This is ridiculous.

I appreciate your patience, Sam. I've just confirmed, and you have nothing to worry about. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Okay. So you'll take them back then?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through. Thanks.
It's on its way as we speak. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sam?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
